product.name: Standout Integrations Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that connects multiple software applications through event-driven workflows and data processing to automate business processes.

product.name: Pre-built Integration Packages
product.description: Ready-to-use integration solutions connecting popular systems like Fortnox, Visma, and SmartDok for quick deployment without setup fees.

product.name: Integration Templates with Customization
product.description: Integration templates that serve as starting points, customizable to fit specific business workflows and data exchange needs.

product.name: Custom Integration Projects
product.description: Bespoke integration development tailored to unique or complex business requirements, built from the ground up with client collaboration.

product.name: Integration Services for Fortnox
product.description: Modular integrations connecting Fortnox accounting and financial services with other business systems to automate data exchange.

product.name: Integration Services for HubSpot
product.description: Integration modules that connect HubSpot CRM and marketing tools with other systems to synchronize customer and sales data.
